<!-- pr-reviewer: 5b23f102bb1dcafed7b9d398debdc902b789bd24 -->
**Ready for the maintainer to merge** (a `feat`: it merges at the next cut).

Review tier: SAFETY. The PR adds a record (`PARAM SectionMode`) to each posted milling operation stream. Thus I examined the posted output, did the mutations again, and checked the goldens.

### What looks good
- The `G93` solver obeys the issue: `dt_cut` uses the part-space tip chord, `dt_lim` uses the stated linear and rotary limits, and `dt_min = max(dt_cut, dt_lim)`.
- A pure rotary move does not divide by zero. A zero-motion move gives `Skip`. Bad feeds, limits and options are refused by name.
- The `F` word is rounded down. Thus rounding never makes a block shorter than `dt_min`.
- `G20` and `G21` give the same `F`.
- `SectionMode` gives three distinct values. An unknown value is refused by name. `Dump::default()` and legacy `.cl` streams do not get the record.
- There is no `unwrap()`, `expect()` or `panic!()` outside tests. Each new module has a provenance line. Each new file is less than 400 lines. The decision file is present.
- The new test files are in the correct crates, and their Gate maps name those crates.

### Results, merged with main (5b23f102b + upstream/main, built locally on Linux)
- `camcraft-post --lib`: 65 passed. `--test g93_feed`: 5 passed.
- `camcraft-app --lib section_mode`: 1 passed. `--test section_mode`: 2 passed.
- 29 posting suites of `camcraft-app` all passed (one run). These are `conformance`, `posting`, `program_comments`, `recorded_post_streams`, `golden_cl`, `solid_law_goldens`, `tilt`, `wcs_tilt`, `wcs_index`, `index_swing`, `c_axis_live_world`, `rotary_feed_cap`, `rotary_field_parity`, `setup_post_options`, `setup_mounts_post`, `per_op_files`, `after_op`, `between_setups`, `program_info`, `post_unit_word`, `self_centering_vise_tilted`, `carvera_post`, `grblhal_post`, `tinyg_post`, `tormach_post`, `lathe_post`, `plasma_post`, `wire_post` and `section_mode`.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-post --all-targets -D warnings`: clean. `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app --lib --bins` and the two new test targets: clean.
- `camcraft-app --test wire_tool` does not compile on the trial merge. The PR does not touch that file. Main has the same fault (issue #2244). Thus it is not a finding for this PR.
- Goldens: the PR changes no `.nc`, `.cl` or snapshot file.

### Mutations (done again by the reviewer)
1. `g93.rs`: `dt_min = dt_cut` (the limit is ignored). Result: `g93_feed` is red (2 failed). Restored.
2. `posting_section_mode.rs`: `tilt().is_some()` changed to `is_none()`. Result: `section_mode` is red (`left: Some("3+2 indexed"), right: Some("3-axis")`). Restored.
3. Probe (local only, deleted after the run): I posted the 3-axis face, the tilted pocket and the Parallel5D streams through all 16 `assets/posts/*.cps` scripts. I posted each stream with `SectionMode` and without it. The program text, the warnings and the refusals were the same in all 48 runs. Thus the marker does not change posted G-code in any post today. The PR pin checks `fanuc.cps` only.

### Requested before merge
None.

### Notes (not blocking, for the downstream issues #1968 and #1969)
1. `crates/post/src/post/g93.rs:307`: the `f_min` clamp increases `F` when a block is longer than 1000 min. Then the block runs faster than `dt_lim` permits. This is improbable, but a refusal is safer than a clamp up.
2. `crates/post/src/post/g93.rs:364`: `format_g93_feed_word` returns `"0"` for a non-finite or non-positive input. A `Result` lets a post refuse by name. It does not write `F0`.
3. `crates/post/src/post/g93.rs:290`: for a pure rotary move with no limits, the fallback reads the feed in mm/min as deg/min. The decision file states this. Make sure that the Mach4 post (#1968) is aware of it.
4. `crates/app/src/posting_section_mode.rs:24`: the classifier reads only the operation `tilt`. An operation in a setup that a rotary indexes (`index_swing`, rotary subplate) gets `3-axis`. The rotary kinds (`RotaryContour` and others, 4-axis wrap) get `simultaneous 5-axis`. These values agree with the issue text. A consumer of the marker must know them.
5. The `g93` items are exported from three paths (`post::g93`, `post::rotary_cap`, `kinematics`). One path is sufficient.
6. `crates/app/src/posting.rs` has 1637 lines (+3 in this PR). The file was already more than the 400-line limit.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
Merged by the order of the maintainer of 2026-11-16 (bulk merge of the merge-ready PRs). No second safety-floor review was made.
